events.title: Woodstock '69 Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite iconic Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost the undisputed King of Rock and Roll. Elvis Presley would have been 91 this year. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The music world remembers influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996 and died six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years ago, we lost a true rap icon. Tupac Shakur would have been 55 this year. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we lost one of the greatest guitarists of all time. Jimi Hendrix would have been 84 this year. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman has given us so many incredible tracks over the years. What's your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem Anniversary
angles.copy: John Lennon's timeless album 'Imagine' was released 55 years ago. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant today as ever. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: The Gadget That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy with The Beatles and as a solo artist continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The Beatles' Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. So many iconic tracks, so much diversity – what's your favourite hidden gem from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. The Queen icon would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
